items.source: Serves as base class for thread factories such as CustomizableThreadFactory.
items.translation: 作为线程工厂（例如 CustomizableThreadFactory）的基类。

items.source: Specify "true" for eager shutdown of threads which still actively execute a Runnable at the time that the application itself shuts down.
items.translation: 将“true”指定为在应用程序本身关闭时，对此时仍积极执行 Runnable 的线程进行急切关闭。

items.source: The default implementation creates a new Thread for the given Runnable, applying an appropriate thread name.
items.translation: 默认实现会为给定的Runnable创建一个新的 Thread，并应用适当的线程名称。

items.source:
Default is "false": Concrete factories usually support explicit cancelling.
Hence, if the application shuts down, Runnables will by default finish their
execution.
items.translation: 默认为"false"：具体工厂通常支持显式取消。因此，如果应用程序关闭，Runnable 默认会完成其执行。

items.source:
The default implementation returns the specified thread name prefix
with an increasing thread count appended: for example, "SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor-0".
items.translation: 默认实现返回指定的线程名前缀，并追加递增的线程计数：例如，"SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor-0"。

items.source: Return the thread group that threads should be created in (or null for the default group).
items.translation: 返回线程应创建的线程组（或为默认组返回 `null`）。

items.source: Create a new CustomizableThreadCreator with default thread name prefix.
items.translation: 创建一个新的具有默认线程名前缀的 CustomizableThreadCreator。

items.source: Create a new CustomizableThreadCreator with the given thread name prefix.
items.translation: 创建一个具有给定线程名前缀的新 CustomizableThreadCreator。

items.source: Build the default thread name prefix for this factory.
items.translation: 为此工厂构建默认线程名前缀。

items.source:
Return the thread name prefix to use for the names of newly
created threads.
items.translation: 返回用于新创建线程名称的前缀。

items.source: Return the priority of the threads that this factory creates.
items.translation: 返回该工厂创建的线程的优先级。

items.source: Return whether this factory should create daemon threads.
items.translation: 返回该工厂是否应创建守护线程。

items.source: Specify the thread group that threads should be created in.
items.translation: 指定线程应创建的线程组。

items.source: Specify the name of the thread group that threads should be created in.
items.translation: 指定线程应创建的线程组名称。

items.source:
Set the priority of the threads that this factory creates.
Default is 5.
items.translation: 设置此工厂创建的线程的优先级。默认值为 5。

items.source: runnable - the Runnable to execute
items.translation: runnable - 要执行的 Runnable

items.source: the default thread name prefix (never null)
items.translation: 默认线程名前缀（永远不为null）

items.source: Template method for the creation of a new Thread.
items.translation: 用于创建新Thread的模板方法。

items.source: Return the thread name to use for a newly created Thread.
items.translation: 返回用于新创建的Thread的线程名称。

items.source:
Set whether this factory is supposed to create daemon threads,
just executing as long as the application itself is running.
items.translation: 设置此工厂是否应创建守护线程，这些线程仅在应用程序运行时执行。

items.source: Specify the prefix to use for the names of newly created threads.
items.translation: 指定用于新创建线程名称的前缀。

items.source: Set the priority of the threads that this factory creates.
items.translation: 设置该工厂所创建线程的优先级。

items.source:
Specify the prefix to use for the names of newly created threads.
Default is "SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor-".
items.translation: 指定用于新创建线程名称的前缀。默认值为"SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor-"。

items.source: threadNamePrefix - the prefix to use for the names of newly created threads
items.translation: threadNamePrefix - 用于新创建线程名称的前缀
